{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
df_clean = df.copy()
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute change in biomarker (final - baseline)
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Now compute mean change by sex, dropping rows with missing baseline
mean_change_by_sex = df_clean.groupby('sex', dropna=False)['change'].mean()

# Also compute the number of complete cases
complete_cases_by_sex = df_clean.groupby('sex', dropna=False)['change'].count()

mean_change_by_sex, complete_cases_by_sex"}
